description: A copyleft (AGPL-3.0-or-later) fork continuing Git Graph's MIT lineage. Visual history, branch actions, and devcontainer support.
command.viewActiveEditorRepo: View Git Graph for Active Editor Repository
config.title: Git Graph Libre
config.autoCenterCommitDetailsView: Automatically center the commit details view when it is opened.
config.commitDetails.fileViewMode: Specifies how changed files are displayed in commit details.
config.commitDetails.fileViewMode.tree: Show changed files grouped by folder
config.commitDetails.fileViewMode.list: Show changed files as a flat path list
config.commitDetails.compactFolders: Collapse single-child folder chains in the commit details file tree.
config.dateFormat: Specifies the date format to be used in the date column of Git Graph.
config.dateFormat.dateTime: Show the date and time, for example "19 Mar 2019 21:34"
config.dateFormat.dateOnly: Show the date only, for example "19 Mar 2019"
config.dateFormat.relative: Show relative times, for example "5 minutes ago"
config.dateType: Specifies the date type to be displayed throughout Git Graph.
config.dateType.authorDate: Use the author date of a commit
config.dateType.commitDate: Use the committer date of a commit
config.columns.signature: Show the commit signature column by default. You can temporarily override it from the table header context menu. Signature verification runs only while the column is visible.
config.fetchAvatars: Fetch avatars of commit authors and committers. By enabling this setting, you consent to commit author and committer email addresses being sent GitHub, GitLab or Gravatar, depending on the repositories remote origin.
config.customBranchGlobPatterns: Custom branch glob presets shown in the Branches dropdown. Each glob is passed to git log as --glob=<pattern>.
config.customBranchGlobPatterns.name: Display name shown in the Branches dropdown.
config.customBranchGlobPatterns.glob: Git ref glob pattern, for example heads/feature/* or refs/remotes/origin/release/*.
config.contextMenuActionsVisibility: Controls which actions are shown in Git Graph context menus. Set known group/action booleans to false to hide them.
config.repository.showRemoteBranches: Show remote branches by default. Repository settings can override this per repository.
config.repository.showStashes: Show stashes by default. Repository settings can override this per repository.
config.repository.showTags: Show tags by default. Repository settings can override this per repository.
config.repository.includeReflog: Include commits only mentioned by reflog entries by default. Repository settings can override this per repository.
config.repository.includeUnreachableComm: Discover and include unreachable commit objects when showing all branches. This scans the Git object database and can be slower on large repositories. Repository settings can override this per repository.
config.repository.onlyFollowFirstParent: Follow only the first parent of commits by default. Repository settings can override this per repository.
config.repository.muteCommitsNotAncestor: Mute commits that are not loaded ancestors of HEAD. This only applies when the HEAD commit is loaded in the graph.
config.repository.muteMergeCommits: Mute the commit message of merge commits as a reading aid. Branch and tag labels always keep full contrast. Disabled by default.
config.repository.boldCheckedOutCommit: Render the checked-out commit's message in bold. Branch and tag labels always keep regular weight. Disabled by default.
config.repository.fetchTagsByDefault: Pre-check "Fetch all tags" in the Fetch dialog. Enabled by default.
config.graphColors: Specifies the colors used on the graph.
config.revealHighlightColor: Specifies the color used to highlight a revealed commit row.
config.graphStyle: Specifies the style of the graph.
config.graphStyle.rounded: Use smooth curves when transitioning between branches on the graph
config.graphStyle.angular: Use angular lines when transitioning between branches on the graph
config.graph.fontSize: Specifies the font size, in pixels, used by graph rows.
config.graph.rowHeight: Specifies the row height, in pixels, used by graph rows.
config.shortHashLength: Specifies the number of characters shown for abbreviated commit hashes.
config.initialLoadCommits: Specifies the number of commits to initially load.
config.loadMoreCommits: Specifies the number of commits to load when the "Load More Commits" button is pressed (only shown when more commits are available).
config.maxDepthOfRepoSearch: Specifies the maximum depth of subfolders to search when discovering repositories in the workspace.
config.showCurrentBranchByDefault: Show the current branch by default when Git Graph is opened. Default: false (show all branches)
config.showStatusBarItem: Show a Status Bar item which opens Git Graph when clicked.
config.showUncommittedChanges: Show uncommitted changes (set to false to decrease load time on large repositories).
config.tabIconColorTheme: Specifies the color theme of the icon displayed on the Git Graph tab.
config.tabIconColorTheme.color: Show a color icon which suits most Visual Studio Code color themes
config.tabIconColorTheme.grey: Show a grey icon which suits Visual Studio Code color themes that are predominantly grayscale
config.telemetry.enabled: Whether to send anonymous usage data about which features are used, so development can be prioritized. Nothing is sent until you choose. Requires Visual Studio Code's own telemetry setting to be enabled; that setting always takes precedence. File names, paths, repository names, branch names, tag names, and commit contents are never sent. [What is sent](https://github.com/PlohnenSoftware/git-graph-libre#telemetry)
config.telemetry.enabled.unset: Not decided yet. Nothing is sent, and the extension will ask.
